summary: BUG: Columns Billable canot be sorted on administration/staff page
reported_issue: On administration/staff each sortable column works except Billable, which could not be sorted.
expected_after_fix: Billable column should sort ascending/descending like the Is Active column.
steps_i_followed: Logged in as admin and opened /administration/staff
Observed the Billable column has an arrow_drop_up sort indicator
Captured initial row order (Billable values mixed)
Clicked the Billable column header once
Clicked the Billable column header a second time
actual_now: Billable column is sortable. Before clicking, Billable values were mixed (Yes/No interleaved). After 1 click all top rows show Billable=No (ascending); after a 2nd click all top rows show Billable=Yes (descending). The header carries a sort arrow indicator.
notes: Sorting behaves consistently with other sortable columns.
